question: What is the average order value?
referenceSql: SELECT SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) AS AverageOrderValue FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId
